text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたと彼は、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and the Onion Knight are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたと彼は、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and the Onion Knight are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp: あらゆる戦法を身につける
text.official_en: Learn various combat strategies.

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
こうして彼はクリスタルをめぐり、
魔王との戦いに勝利しますが――
text.official_en: Having made due preparations, the Onion Knight claimed victory over his thaumaturgical foe.
text.real_en: He journeyed among the Crystals and defeated the dark lord, but...

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
さまざまな戦い方を試すことで
なりたい自分が見つかるでしょう。
text.official_en: The lesson here is: the more options you are given, the more likely you are to find your ideal self.
text.real_en: By trying different ways of fighting, you may discover the person you want to become.

text.jp: それは、闇の氾濫に揺れ動く異界の記憶――
text.official_en: Darkness swelled and surged, flooding the land and upsetting the balance.
text.real_en: These are memories of another world shaken by a flood of darkness—

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
はじまりの未熟な姿にこそ、最強の可能性が
秘められているかもしれません。
text.official_en: Many an adventurer would do well to remember: it is possible for even a younger tree to produce a harvest.
text.real_en: Perhaps the greatest potential lies in the inexperienced person you once were.

text.jp:
クリスタルは、希望を持つ者に
力ある称号を授けます。
text.official_en: Those in whom the crystals place their hope are also blessed with titles that bestow powers.
text.real_en: The Crystals bestow powerful titles upon those who carry hope.

text.jp:
バハムートをはじめとする幻獣たちが
光ある者の挑戦を待っています。
text.official_en: Creatures of monstrous puissance, such as Bahamut, await those imbued with the light of the crystals.
text.real_en: Bahamut and other powerful Eidolons await challenges from those who bear the light.

text.jp:
世界をめぐり多くの経験を積んでから
原点に返ることも有益です。
text.official_en: Though the fruits of a long, arduous journey may be both plentiful and sweet, they did not grow from nothing.
text.real_en: After traveling the world and gaining experience, it can be worthwhile to return to where you began.

text.jp:
世界を救う旅のさなか、自由な空を
飛ぶひとときが、安らぎとなります。
text.official_en: Heavy is the burden you carry as a hero. Taking to the air, however, is a fine time to lighten your mental load.
text.real_en: During a journey to save the world, time spent flying through the open sky can offer some peace.

text.jp:
世界を照らすクリスタルが
次々と闇に沈みゆく災いのさなか……
text.official_en: One by one, the crystals and their light succumbed to the torrent. Yet all was not lost.
text.real_en: As the Crystals that lit the world fell into darkness one by one...

text.jp:
世界を照らすクリスタルの光が
魔王ザンデに消されようとしています。
text.official_en: All in the name of thwarting the nefarious Xande, who wished to drain the crystals of their power.
text.real_en: The Dark Lord Xande sought to extinguish the light of the Crystals that illuminated the world.

text.jp:
世界を闇につつもうとする魔王に
どうやって立ち向かうのか――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to confront a foe who was not only powerful, but also had an expert command of magic, how would you fell them?
text.real_en: How would you stand against a dark lord determined to envelop the world in darkness?

text.jp: 信じてくれた人々を想う
text.official_en: Remember those who believe in you.

text.jp:
傷つき涙を流しても、くじけなければ
ひと皮むけて、たくましくなれるでしょう。
text.official_en: Though you may drip blood, though you may shed tears, your undying tenacity will undoubtedly make those around you stronger.
text.real_en: Even if you are wounded and shed tears, you can grow stronger by refusing to give in.

text.jp:
光と闇が手をとりあい、同じ世界を守る。
そんな幻想が、現実となります。
text.official_en: Though the two elements may appear to be in opposition, the Warriors of the Dark fought for the same cause as the Warriors of the Light.
text.real_en: Light and darkness joined hands to protect the same world. What once seemed a fantasy became real.

text.jp:
光と闇のすべてを無に帰す
「暗闇の雲」に敗れてしまいます。
text.official_en: Yet he soon fell to the Cloud of Darkness, an eldritch fiend bent on returning all to nothingness.
text.real_en: He was defeated by the Cloud of Darkness, who sought to reduce both light and darkness to nothingness.

text.jp:
冒険には、潜水艇や巨大船など
さまざまな飛空艇が登場します。
text.official_en: And as many airships exist—including submergible ones—you should have ample chance to do so.
text.real_en: The adventure features all kinds of airships, including submarines and enormous vessels.

text.jp:
出会った人たちに託された想いを
ふりかえることが、力になります。
text.official_en: A valid choice, as the faith that others place in you can often serve as a source of strength.
text.real_en: Remembering the hopes entrusted to you by those you have met can give you strength.

text.jp: 原点に回帰してみる
text.official_en: Go back to the basics.

text.jp: 幻獣に認めてもらう
text.official_en: Earn the respect of summoned entities.
text.real_en: Earn the recognition of the Eidolons.

text.jp: 広い世界を見てまわる
text.official_en: See as much of the world as possible.

text.jp:
強大な幻獣たちに勝つことができれば
その力を得られるでしょう。
text.official_en: Vanquishing each and gaining their respect—along with their powers—is a sound strategy.
text.real_en: If you can defeat those mighty Eidolons, you may gain their power.

text.jp:
彼の冒険は、故郷の世界を飛び出し、
異なる世界にまで広がるのです。
text.official_en: The Onion Knight broadened his, as he journeyed not only around his own world, but to others as well.

text.jp:
彼の想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.

text.jp:
彼は、オニオンナイト……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: Among them was the Onion Knight, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: His name was the Onion Knight... Your feelings will form a bond with him.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. Now, suppose you...

text.jp:
悠久の風そよぐ異界の幻影　オニオンナイト
クリスタルの輝きは、少年の胸に。
text.official_en:
Eternal Wind Conservator Onion Knight
The young warrior who bears of the light of the crystals.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision borne on an eternal wind: the Onion Knight. The Crystals’ light shines in the boy’s heart.

text.jp: 敗北しても挫折しない
text.official_en: Persevere in the face of adversity.

text.jp: 最強の戦い方をつきつめる
text.official_en: Find what works best against them.
text.real_en: Perfect the strongest way of fighting.

text.jp:
最強の武器や魔法をあやつる称号でも
ひとりで戦うことはできません。
text.official_en: No matter how well one may wield a blade or sling a spell, no one should ever fight their battles alone.
text.real_en: Even with a title that lets you wield the strongest weapons and magic, you cannot fight alone.

text.jp:
村はずれの洞窟で、思いがけなく
クリスタルに選ばれた少年がいました。
text.official_en: Deep in a cave on the outskirts of a remote village, four fated youths were chosen by one of the crystals.
text.real_en: A boy was unexpectedly chosen by a Crystal in a cave outside his village.

text.jp:
生まれ育った村を離れて
探求の旅に出るなら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to embark on a lengthy journey, trading your small village for the wider world, what would you do?

text.jp:
真の強さを求めるなら、仲間とそれぞれの
称号の能力を組みあわせて戦いましょう。
text.official_en: It is only when you fight alongside others—when your powers combine to greater effect—that you can unleash your true potential.
text.real_en: If you seek true strength, fight alongside your companions by combining the abilities of your different titles.

text.jp:
突如として現れた最強の敵に
打ちのめされたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were a mysterious foe to appear before you—as if from thin air—and put you to rout, what would you do?

text.jp:
老賢人ドーガとウネの導きによって
希望はよみがえり、彼は無に挑むのです。
text.official_en: For instance, thanks to Doga’s and Unei’s sacrifice, hope was restored and the Onion Knight could enter the World of Darkness.
text.real_en: Guided by the wise elders Doga and Unei, hope returned, and he challenged the void.

text.jp:
見知らぬ世界を見てみたい、あこがれが
困難に立ち向かう力となります。
text.official_en: A fine choice, as travel should allow you to broaden your horizons—in both the literal and figurative sense.
text.real_en: The desire to see an unknown world can give you the strength to face hardship.

text.jp:
負けてもあきらめずに挑みつづける、
そんな姿勢に、希望は芽吹きます。
text.official_en: The rise of a fallen soldier is a powerful sight, as it can inspire even the most weary of recruits.
text.real_en: Hope begins to grow when you rise after defeat and refuse to give up.

text.jp:
辺境の村から始まった旅は、浮遊大陸を
飛び出し、海に沈んだ世界へ。
text.official_en: What began as a departure from a small village burgeoned into an odyssey spanning floating continents and undersea realms...
text.real_en: A journey that began in a remote village carried him beyond the floating continent and into a world submerged beneath the sea.

text.jp: 闇の助けを借りる
text.official_en: Seek aid from those on the side of darkness.
text.real_en: Seek help from the darkness.

text.jp:
闇の戦士たちが決戦の場に現れ、
「暗闇の雲」の力を封じたのです。
text.official_en: Due to this alliance, the Cloud of Darkness was defeated, and what once seemed mere fantasy was made reality.
text.real_en: The Warriors of Darkness arrived at the final battle and sealed away the Cloud of Darkness’s power.

text.jp: 飛空艇に乗ってみたい
text.official_en: Ride on an airship.
